snippet.title: LuganoBay — Official Trailer ⚓ Redesigned Interface
snippet.description:
⚓ Take a fresh look at Lugano Bay Tycoon with this updated trailer featuring the redesigned interface!

Organize boats at your docks, decorate your waterfront, and set your rental prices as you bring your corner of the bay to life.

🎬 This updated version of the trailer showcases the new interface while keeping the same overview of the game.

✨ What’s new in the latest game update:

🖥️ A completely redesigned interface
🎨 Improved activity visuals
🍂 Autumn and winter weather
🚤 The ability to arrange boats at the docks
🌿 More room for decorations, with the area slightly expanded toward the lake
💬 Feedback from passersby on rental prices
📖 Clearer explanations for two introductory tutorial steps

🎮 Find Lugano Bay Tycoon on Steam:
store.steampowered.com/app/5235040/LUGANO_BAY_TYCOON

❤️ Thank you to everyone who has shared feedback and suggestions. Your support means a lot to me and helps shape the future of LuganoBay

Let me know what you think of the new interface in the comments!

#LuganoBayTycoon #IndieGame #Steam #lugano
